children: RNS Number : 5017U  Buccaneer Energy PLC  11 September 2026

Buccaneer Energy (AIM: BUCE), the international oil & gas exploration and production company, was informed on 11 September 2026 that as a result of dilution from the recent equity fundraising, Bono Energy Group Limited's shareholding of 1,147,460,000 ordinary shares in the Company now represents 4.95 per cent. of the total voting rights of the Company (previously 6.18 per cent.).
Equity Sales - Kelly Gardiner / Amrit Nahal
Corporate Finance - Jeremy Porter / Alex Brearley / David Asquith
SP Angel Corporate Finance LLP (Joint Broker)
Stuart Gledhill / Richard Hail / Adam Cowl
